metadata.title: 200,000 Indie Developer Checkout Links and Payment Platform Adoption Dataset (2023–2026)
metadata.description: Empirical dataset analyzing ~200,000 indie sellers across 198,000 websites linking to checkout pages across 8 payment platforms (Stripe, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Polar, Creem, Dodo Payments, Paddle, Waffo) between 2023 and November 2026. Shows that 82,000 new sellers launched in 2026 (up from 56,000 in 2025), software sellers quadrupled from 5% to 20%, and 24%–29% of new sellers on Merchant of Record platforms (Dodo Payments, Polar, Creem) ship AI products versus 7% on Stripe. Maintained by Jason Zhu at https://jasonzhu.ai/en/blog/indie-payments-report-2026.
keywords: Stripe vs Polar vs Dodo Payments vs Creem
